correctness.rationale: For \(a>0\), the treatment \(T_b(I)=aI/(b+I)\) has \(T_b(0)=0\) for every \(b>0\), but at fixed \(I>0\) tends to \(a\) as \(b\downarrow0\). Substitution into the exact source vector field at \(S=A/(\mu_1+\gamma+\delta)\), \(B=0\) gives the one-sided limit \((a,-a,0)\). Thus no continuous extension agreeing with the positive-\(I\) \(b=0\) dynamics has the nominal disease-free equilibrium. The source's own equation (3.9) independently gives infected derivative \((-a,0)\) at that state. The symbolic verifier replays these identities exactly.

value.rationale: The source makes the \(b=0\) case central to its disease-eradication conclusion: it claims that removing treatment saturation eliminates backward bifurcation and makes the disease-free state globally attracting. The exact endpoint calculation shows that this parameter operation destroys the smooth disease-free vector field on which that conclusion depends. The defect is structural and parameter-independent for \(a>0\), and the source's own equation (3.9) exposes it directly.
